reviewFindings: Separate review read all five new source payloads and twelve packet bindings, four lessons, fourteen MC items with all forty-two wrong-option rationales, three unfamiliar cases, one mentor, every part of one writing task and eight card backs.

All eighteen existing official statement strings and every prior catalog entity are preserved. Seven source IDs match both URL and full SHA-256; five unmatched snapshots are appended. The unhashed S6 index locator is excluded.

Fourteen distinct decision families sample V1-V9 and V11-V15; the non-math mentor supplies V10 breadth. Four equivalent earlier decision families are retained to avoid treating variants as fresh independence.

Corrected the public-sample appendix distractor to cite S4 explicitly. Clarified that writing creates no automatic independent evidence or score while the existing store may record pending/ineligible bookkeeping.
Original writing practice targets grade 8, consistent with the elementary/middle-school scope of S11. Recommendation 3 remains Minimal; no causal effect, timeline or learner trait is invented.

Parts II-V are original and unofficial. The mentor is authored and hash-bound, the existing rubric remains verbatim, U/B gates precede the single holistic judgment, and no numeric analytic rubric or official scorer claim is introduced.

Twenty-seven narrow coverage bindings retain explicit gaps; all objectives remain incomplete. Guided work, card practice and model-only content review confer no independent learner evidence or human-review promotion.
